description: This file defines an abstract test runner class for transaction fault testing in Orleans, involving multi-grain transaction scenarios with simulated failures and exceptions.

classes.name: TocFaultTransactionTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing test scenarios for transaction faults, including commit failures and exceptions, within Orleans transactions.

methods.name: MultiGrainWriteTransactionWithCommitFailure
methods.description: Executes a multi-grain transaction and verifies behavior when a commit failure occurs, expecting an OrleansTransactionAbortedException.

methods.name: MultiGrainWriteTransactionWithCommitException
methods.description: Executes a multi-grain transaction and verifies behavior when a commit throws an exception, expecting an OrleansTransactionInDoubtException.
